# Your Functional Health

> Functional medicine practice in Austin, Texas, led by Xenia Kempf, MSN, APRN, FNP-C. In person in Austin and by secure video anywhere in Texas, including Austin, Round Rock, Cedar Park, Georgetown, San Antonio, Houston, Dallas, Midland, Odessa, Lubbock, Amarillo, San Angelo, Tyler and Beaumont. Cash-pay with published prices; HSA/FSA accepted; superbills for out-of-network reimbursement.

Phone or text: 737-336-5959. Free 15-minute discovery call: https://www.yourfunctionalmednp.com/#contact

## Services

- [Functional Medicine](https://www.yourfunctionalmednp.com/functional-medicine-austin): Root-cause functional medicine care for gut health, hormones, thyroid, metabolic health, fatigue and autoimmunity, with advanced lab testing and a personalized plan.
- [Integrative Direct Primary Care](https://www.yourfunctionalmednp.com/integrative-primary-care): Membership primary care for adults in Texas: virtual primary and urgent care visits, unlimited messaging and extensive lab testing twice a year.
- [Integrative Psychiatry](https://www.yourfunctionalmednp.com/functional-integrative-psychiatry-texas): Integrative and metabolic psychiatry for anxiety, depression and ADHD, combining medication management with nutrition, lab testing and lifestyle care.
- [Menopause Care and Bioidentical Hormone Replacement Therapy (BHRT)](https://www.yourfunctionalmednp.com/menopause-clinic-texas): Menopause and perimenopause care with FDA-approved bioidentical hormones (no pellets), lab testing before any prescription and regular monitoring.
- [GLP-1 Weight Loss Program](https://www.yourfunctionalmednp.com/glp1-weight-loss-texas): Semaglutide or tirzepatide at the lowest effective dose, with nutrition guidance and metabolic care, by video anywhere in Texas.
- [Peptide Therapy](https://www.yourfunctionalmednp.com/peptide-therapy-austin): Clinician-supervised peptide therapy in Austin and by video across Texas.
- [Mold Detox and Mold Illness Treatment](https://www.yourfunctionalmednp.com/mold-detox-in-texas): Testing and phased treatment for mold illness and mycotoxin exposure, including binders, gut and nutrient support and practical remediation guidance.
- [Functional Medicine Lab Testing](https://www.yourfunctionalmednp.com/functional-medicine-lab-testing): At-home functional lab tests: gut, mycotoxins, environmental toxins, organic acids, hormones, food sensitivities, methylation and genetics.
